citation: State of Delhi v. Kishore Kumar (2019) 10 SCC 567
reasoning_summary: Conviction under IPC 307 for attempt to murder. Multiple stab wounds in vital areas showed intention to kill. CCTV captured accused attacking victim. Doctor testified injuries were life-threatening.

facts_established.actus_reus: Accused stabbed victim in chest and abdomen
facts_established.mens_rea: Intention to kill proven - vital parts targeted
facts_established.chain_of_custody: Weapon recovered, accused identified on CCTV
